title.zh-CN: 乏力、纳差与皮肤瘀斑 · 57岁男性
title.en: Fatigue, poor appetite and bruising · 57-year-old man

summary.zh-CN: 乏力、纳差伴皮肤瘀斑，外院查见全血细胞减少，转入血液科进一步诊治。
summary.en: Fatigue, poor appetite and bruising with pancytopenia found at another hospital; admitted to haematology for further assessment.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 识别不支持急性髓系白血病的特征（无Auer小体、POX阴性、谱系标志阴性、病程缓慢、CD56表达），在骨髓“原始细胞”增多时暂缓诱导化疗。
learningOutcomes.en: Recognise the features that argue against AML despite many marrow “blasts” — no Auer rods, a negative POX, a lineage-negative immunophenotype, a slow course, CD56 expression — and hold off induction.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 在任何诱导化疗之前，安排骨髓活检免疫组化并寻找实体瘤原发灶（胸部CT、PET-CT、肿瘤标志物）。
learningOutcomes.en: Order a marrow trephine with immunohistochemistry and a search for a solid primary (chest CT, PET-CT, tumour markers) before any induction chemotherapy.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 把上皮/神经内分泌免疫组化谱（AE1/AE3、CAM5.2、Syn、CgA阳性，MPO、LCA阴性）解读为转移性小细胞癌，结合影像和NSE、ProGRP推定肺原发，并分期为广泛期（TNM第8版：N3、M1）。
learningOutcomes.en: Interpret an epithelial/neuroendocrine immunohistochemical profile (AE1/AE3, CAM5.2, synaptophysin, CgA positive; MPO, LCA negative) as metastatic small-cell carcinoma, infer a lung primary from imaging, NSE and ProGRP, and stage it as extensive disease (TNM 8th edition: N3, M1).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 解释小细胞肺癌的副肿瘤低钠（SIADH）和异位胰酶升高，安排SIADH评估，并按欧洲指南（2014）的速度上限安全纠正慢性低钠。
learningOutcomes.en: Explain paraneoplastic hyponatraemia (SIADH) and ectopic pancreatic-enzyme production in small-cell lung cancer, and plan the SIADH work-up and a safe correction rate for chronic hyponatraemia (European guideline 2014).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 说明为什么胸片正常不能排除中心型肺肿瘤（原报告引用的敏感度约26%），对可疑患者尽早做胸部CT。
learningOutcomes.en: Explain why a normal chest X-ray does not exclude a central lung tumour (the report quotes a sensitivity of about 26 %), and get an early chest CT when lung cancer is suspected.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 对伴发热、新肺部阴影和呼吸衰竭的免疫低下患者，立即给氧、经验性抗感染（SSC 2021）和血制品支持，并及早与患者及家属讨论治疗目标。
learningOutcomes.en: Manage fever with a new lung opacity and respiratory failure in an immunocompromised patient — oxygen, prompt empirical antibiotics (SSC 2021) and blood products — and open an early goals-of-care conversation with the patient and family.

chiefComplaint.zh-CN: 乏力、食欲下降3个月，皮肤瘀斑1周
chiefComplaint.en: Tiredness and poor appetite for three months; bruising for one week

triageNote.zh-CN: 57岁男性，乏力、纳差3个月，皮肤瘀斑1周；外院查见全血细胞减少后转来，今日收入血液科病房。病史待询问。
triageNote.en: 57-year-old man with three months of tiredness and poor appetite and a week of bruising; transferred after another hospital found pancytopenia, and admitted to the haematology ward today. History still to be taken.

personality.zh-CN: 57岁男性，三个月来越来越没力气，又辗转了两家医院，人很疲惫；配合，话不多，最想知道自己到底得了什么病。
personality.en: A 57-year-old man worn down by three months of growing weakness and two hospitals; cooperative and quiet, and above all wants to know what is really wrong with him.

speechStyle.zh-CN: 普通话口语，句子短，说话有气无力；医学名词只会转述医生告诉他的说法（“白血病”“胰腺炎”）。
speechStyle.en: Plain speech in short, tired sentences; uses medical words only as he was told them (“leukaemia”, “pancreatitis”).

openingLine.zh-CN: 医生，我这三个月老是没劲儿，吃不下饭，越来越重了。
openingLine.en: Doctor, for three months I've had no energy and I can't eat, and it's getting worse.

fallbackUnknown.zh-CN: 这个我的病例里没有记录，我说不上来。
fallbackUnknown.en: That isn't recorded in my case notes, so I can't really say.

concerns.zh-CN: 那边医院说是白血病，到底是不是？
concerns.en: The other hospital said it was leukaemia — is it really?

actingNotes.zh-CN: 躺在病床上，说话慢、容易累，偶尔低头看肚子上的青紫。只说病例里有的事实；医生没告诉他的检查数值、诊断和治疗一概不说；被问到没有记录的事，就用兜底的那句话回答。
actingNotes.en: Lies in bed, speaks slowly and tires easily, now and then glancing at the bruises on his abdomen. Says only what his record holds; never states test values, diagnoses or treatments he has not been told; answers anything unrecorded with the fallback line.

persona.zh-CN: 陪同住院的家属（原报告没有写明与患者的关系）；焦虑但克制，关心诊断和下一步怎么治。不回答病史问题，只在谈到病情、预后和治疗意愿时参与谈话；不说出病例里没有的事实。
persona.en: The relative staying with him in hospital (the report does not say how they are related); anxious but composed, wanting to know the diagnosis and what comes next. Does not answer history questions; joins in when the illness, the outlook and wishes about treatment are discussed, and states no fact the case does not hold.

nonVerbalReason.zh-CN: 原报告中，他当天病情持续恶化、氧合无法维持，已不能交谈。
nonVerbalReason.en: In the report he kept deteriorating that day and his oxygenation could not be maintained; he can no longer talk.

name.en: Hyponatraemia: find the cause and correct it slowly

dose.zh-CN: 评估容量状态，送检血、尿渗透压和尿钠；若符合SIADH，先限制入液量；定期复查血钠，24小时内升高不超过10 mmol/L，此后每24小时不超过8 mmol/L，高危者（如长期大量饮酒、营养不良）目标更保守
dose.en: Assess volume status and send serum and urine osmolality and urine sodium; if it is SIADH, restrict fluids first; recheck the sodium regularly, keeping the rise to no more than 10 mmol/L in the first 24 h and 8 mmol/L in each 24 h after — lower targets for high-risk patients (such as heavy drinkers or the malnourished)

response.zh-CN: 低钠血症的评估和缓慢纠正计划已下达，护士按医嘱复查血钠。
response.en: The hyponatraemia work-up and slow-correction plan are ordered; the nurses will recheck the sodium as instructed.

dose.zh-CN: 3%氯化钠150 mL，20分钟内静脉输注，可重复
dose.en: 3 % sodium chloride 150 mL IV over 20 min, repeatable

harm.zh-CN: 他的低钠是慢性的，神志清楚、没有严重症状：高渗盐水推注只用于有严重症状（如抽搐、昏迷、心肺窘迫）的低钠血症。过快升高血钠会引起渗透性脱髓鞘，长期大量饮酒和营养不良使他属于高危。
harm.en: His hyponatraemia is chronic and he is alert without severe symptoms: a hypertonic saline bolus is only for hyponatraemia with severe symptoms (such as seizures, coma or cardiorespiratory distress). Raising the sodium too fast causes osmotic demyelination, and heavy drinking and malnutrition put him at high risk.

response.en: The hypertonic saline bolus is running.

name.zh-CN: 静脉补钠，力争24小时内把血钠纠正到正常
name.en: IV sodium to bring the level back to normal within 24 hours

dose.zh-CN: 静脉补充氯化钠，目标24小时内血钠≥135 mmol/L
dose.en: IV sodium chloride aiming for a sodium of ≥ 135 mmol/L within 24 hours

harm.zh-CN: 从121 mmol/L在24小时内纠正到正常，升幅远超每24小时10 mmol/L的上限；慢性低钠时大脑已经适应，过快纠正会引起渗透性脱髓鞘，饮酒和营养不良使他风险更高。
harm.en: Going from 121 mmol/L to normal in 24 hours far exceeds the limit of 10 mmol/L per 24 hours; the brain has adapted to chronic hyponatraemia, and over-rapid correction causes osmotic demyelination — a higher risk with his drinking and malnutrition.

name.zh-CN: 按急性髓系白血病开始诱导化疗（“3+7”方案）

dose.zh-CN: 柔红霉素60 mg/m²静脉注射，第1–3天；阿糖胞苷100–200 mg/m²/日持续静脉输注，第1–7天
dose.en: Daunorubicin 60 mg/m² IV on days 1–3 plus cytarabine 100–200 mg/m²/day by continuous IV infusion on days 1–7

harm.zh-CN: 急性髓系白血病的诊断并不成立：“原始细胞”无Auer小体、POX阴性，髓系和其他谱系标志大多阴性，病程也不像未治疗的急性白血病。对浸润骨髓的转移癌给予强烈诱导化疗，只会加重骨髓抑制、感染和出血，却治不了真正的病。应先做骨髓活检免疫组化并寻找实体瘤原发灶。
harm.en: The diagnosis of AML does not stand: the “blasts” have no Auer rods and a negative POX, most myeloid and other lineage markers are negative, and the course is not that of untreated acute leukaemia. Intensive induction for what is in fact a carcinoma infiltrating the marrow only deepens marrow suppression, infection and bleeding without treating the real disease. Get the trephine immunohistochemistry and look for a solid primary first.

harm.en: He has no abdominal pain this time, abdominal imaging is essentially normal and the enzymes did not fall with pancreatitis treatment — there is not enough evidence of acute pancreatitis, so the raised enzymes need another explanation; more fasting only worsens his malnutrition (he has lost 14 kg).

dose.zh-CN: 与接收专科交接后转科，由专科制定治疗方案
dose.en: Hand over to the receiving specialty and transfer, for them to plan treatment

response.zh-CN: 肿瘤科接收，他当天转入肿瘤科病房。
response.en: Oncology accepts him, and he moves to the oncology ward the same day.

dose.zh-CN: 储氧面罩，氧流量15 L/min，按SpO₂调整
dose.en: Reservoir mask at 15 L/min, titrated to the SpO₂

response.zh-CN: 已给储氧面罩吸氧，护士持续观察他的氧合。
response.en: Reservoir-mask oxygen is on; the nurse keeps watching his oxygenation.

name.zh-CN: 美罗培南经验性抗感染

dose.zh-CN: 美罗培南1 g静脉滴注，每8小时一次（原报告没有写剂量；此为肾功能正常成人的常用剂量）
dose.en: Meropenem 1 g IV every 8 hours (the report gives no dose; this is a usual adult dose with normal renal function)

response.zh-CN: 美罗培南已开始静脉滴注。若还没有留取血培养，应立即留取，但不要因此推迟用药。
response.en: Meropenem is running IV. If blood cultures have not been taken, take them now — but do not delay the antibiotic for them.

name.zh-CN: 与患者及家属沟通病情和治疗目标（包括是否进一步抢救）
name.en: Talk with him and his family about the illness and the goals of care, including further resuscitation

dose.zh-CN: 坦诚说明诊断、病情的严重程度和可能的走向，了解他和家属的意愿，共同决定是否进入重症监护、是否进一步抢救
dose.en: Explain the diagnosis, how serious things are and what may happen; find out his and his family's wishes; decide together about intensive care and further resuscitation

response.zh-CN: 你已与他和家属谈话，并记录了他们的意愿。
response.en: You have talked with him and his family and recorded their wishes.

title.zh-CN: 梳理起病经过、外院诊治和查体
title.en: Piece together the illness, the earlier care and the examination

hint.zh-CN: 起病快还是慢？外院给了什么诊断、治疗后怎样？哪些症状支持那个诊断，哪些不支持？查体时要重点看哪些出血和浸润的体征？
hint.en: Did this come on quickly or slowly? What did the other hospital diagnose, and how did he respond? Which symptoms fit that label — and which don't? Which signs of bleeding or infiltration will you look for?

guidance.zh-CN: 到他床旁询问病史并完成查体。
guidance.en: Take his history at the bedside and examine him.

title.zh-CN: 核对已有资料，决定下一步
title.en: Review the records and decide what comes next

hint.zh-CN: 这些“原始细胞”像典型的急性髓系白血病吗？哪些结果用白血病解释不通？在开始任何强烈治疗之前还缺什么证据？低钠应该怎样评估、纠正多快？
hint.en: Do these “blasts” look like typical AML? Which results can leukaemia not explain? What evidence is still missing before any intensive treatment? How should the low sodium be assessed, and how fast corrected?

guidance.zh-CN: 在病历终端调阅外院和本院急诊的资料，然后到会诊板作出两项决策。
guidance.en: Read the outside and emergency records at a records terminal, then make the two decisions at the case board.

title.zh-CN: 寻找原发灶并明确诊断
title.en: Find the primary and make the diagnosis

hint.zh-CN: 哪项检查能直接回答骨髓里是什么细胞？如果是实体瘤，原发灶最可能在哪里，用什么检查去找？确诊之后由谁接手？
hint.en: Which test answers directly what the cells in the marrow are? If it is a solid tumour, where is the primary most likely to be, and how will you find it? Who takes over once the diagnosis is made?

guidance.zh-CN: 在入院后阶段重新开具并调阅检查，到会诊板作出诊断，然后安排转科。
guidance.en: In the post-admission phase, order and read the tests, make the diagnosis at the case board, then arrange the transfer.

title.zh-CN: 处理转科当天的急性恶化
title.en: Manage the sudden deterioration on the day of transfer

hint.zh-CN: 发热加新的肺部阴影，在这个血小板极低、免疫低下的患者身上要想到什么？哪些处理一刻也不能等？谁需要参与决定接下来怎么办？
hint.en: In a man with very low platelets and weak defences, what does fever with a new lung shadow make you think of? What cannot wait? Who needs to be part of deciding what happens next?

guidance.zh-CN: 到床旁重新评估，开具床旁胸片和血气，到会诊板作出决策并开始处理。
guidance.en: Reassess him at the bedside, get the bedside chest X-ray and a blood gas, decide at the case board and start treatment.

title.en: Check the outcome in the report

hint.zh-CN: 原报告的救治做了什么？结局怎样？哪些原因到最后仍不清楚？
hint.en: What did the report's team do, and what happened? Which causes were never established?

guidance.zh-CN: 在病历终端调阅原报告的后续记录。
guidance.en: Read the report's record of what followed at a records terminal.

prompt.zh-CN: 骨髓涂片“原始细胞”0.76，但未见Auer小体、POX阴性，异常细胞群只表达CD15、CD117，其余髓系及各谱系标志多为阴性；同时低钠持续、胰酶升高，外院按急性髓系白血病、急性胰腺炎处理无效。下一步最合适的是？
prompt.en: The marrow smear shows 76 % “blasts”, but no Auer rods and a negative POX, and the abnormal population expresses only CD15 and CD117, with most myeloid and other lineage markers negative; meanwhile the sodium stays low and the pancreatic enzymes high, and treatment for AML and acute pancreatitis elsewhere has not helped. What is the best next step?

need.zh-CN: 先询问外院的诊治经过，并调阅外院血液检查、本院急诊骨髓涂片与免疫分型及胰酶资料。
need.en: First ask about the care at the other hospital, and read the outside blood tests, this hospital's emergency marrow smear and immunophenotyping, and the enzyme results.

text.zh-CN: 暂不诱导化疗：先给支持治疗，追查骨髓活检病理及免疫组化，并寻找实体瘤原发灶（如胸部CT）
text.en: Hold off induction chemotherapy: give supportive care, chase the marrow trephine histology and immunohistochemistry, and look for a solid primary (for example with a chest CT)

feedback.zh-CN: 正确，也是原报告团队的做法。形态、细胞化学和免疫分型都不典型，病程也不像未治疗的急性白血病，还有白血病解释不了的低钠和胰酶升高——应先排除骨髓转移癌。作者在入院后第5天明确了诊断。
feedback.en: Correct — and what the report's team did. Morphology, cytochemistry and immunophenotype are all atypical, the course is not that of untreated acute leukaemia, and leukaemia does not explain the hyponatraemia or the raised enzymes — so a carcinoma metastatic to the marrow must be excluded first. The authors had the diagnosis on hospital day 5.

text.zh-CN: 诱导化疗不能拖：骨髓原始细胞已达76%，今天就按急性髓系白血病开始“3+7”诱导
text.en: Induction can't wait — the marrow has 76 % blasts, so start “7 + 3” induction for AML today

feedback.zh-CN: 不合适。“原始细胞”比例高不等于急性髓系白血病：本例无Auer小体、POX阴性、谱系标志大多阴性，这个诊断并不成立。谱系判断错误时给予强烈化疗，只会造成严重的骨髓抑制、感染和出血。
feedback.en: Not appropriate. A high proportion of “blasts” does not make it AML: with no Auer rods, a negative POX and mostly negative lineage markers, that diagnosis is unproven. Intensive chemotherapy given on the wrong lineage brings profound marrow suppression, infection and bleeding.

text.zh-CN: 先继续按急性胰腺炎禁食、补液、抑酸，等胰酶降下来再评估骨髓
text.en: Keep treating acute pancreatitis — nil by mouth, fluids, acid suppression — until the enzymes fall, then reassess the marrow

feedback.zh-CN: 不合适。他这次没有腹痛，外院腹部超声大致正常，禁食、补液、抑酸后胰酶也没有下降——急性胰腺炎证据不足；继续禁食只会加重营养不良。胰酶升高需要另找原因。
feedback.en: Not appropriate. He has no abdominal pain this time, the earlier abdominal ultrasound was essentially normal, and the enzymes did not fall with fasting, fluids and acid suppression — there is not enough evidence of acute pancreatitis, and more fasting only worsens his malnutrition. The raised enzymes need another explanation.

text.zh-CN: 先把血钠尽快纠正到正常，再考虑其他检查
text.en: Correct the sodium to normal as fast as possible first, then think about other tests

feedback.zh-CN: 不合适。他的低钠是慢性的，神志清楚、没有严重症状，不需要也不应该快速纠正：过快升高血钠可致渗透性脱髓鞘，长期大量饮酒和营养不良使他风险更高。低钠本身是诊断线索，应查明原因。
feedback.en: Not appropriate. His hyponatraemia is chronic and he is alert with no severe symptoms, so it neither needs nor should get rapid correction: raising the sodium too fast can cause osmotic demyelination, and heavy drinking and malnutrition put him at higher risk. The low sodium is itself a clue — find its cause.

prompt.zh-CN: 外院血钠121 mmol/L，入院后低钠持续、补钠效果不明显；他神志清楚，没有严重症状。他长期大量饮酒，体重下降了14 kg。低钠血症的处理最合适的是？
prompt.en: The sodium was 121 mmol/L at the other hospital and has stayed low since admission despite supplementation; he is alert with no severe symptoms. He has a long history of heavy drinking and has lost 14 kg. What is the best approach to the hyponatraemia?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅外院血液检查和入院后的电解质记录，评估他的神志，并询问饮酒和体重变化。
need.en: First read the outside blood tests and the electrolyte record since admission, assess his consciousness, and ask about alcohol and weight.

text.zh-CN: 按慢性、无严重症状的低钠处理：评估容量状态，查血、尿渗透压和尿钠（甲状腺功能外院正常，肾上腺皮质功能还需评估），针对病因治疗；如需纠正，24小时内升高不超过10 mmol/L、此后每24小时不超过8 mmol/L，并因饮酒和营养不良取更保守的目标
text.en: Treat it as chronic hyponatraemia without severe symptoms: assess volume status, send serum and urine osmolality and urine sodium (thyroid function was normal elsewhere; adrenal function still needs assessing), and treat the cause; if correcting, keep the rise to no more than 10 mmol/L in the first 24 h and 8 mmol/L in each 24 h after, aiming lower because of his drinking and malnutrition

feedback.zh-CN: 正确（欧洲低钠血症指南2014）。SIADH是排除性诊断：需要低血浆渗透压、尿液不适当浓缩、尿钠、临床容量正常，以及甲状腺和肾上腺功能正常等依据。原报告入院初期没有查渗透压和尿钠（作者认为当时首要的是尽快明确原发病）。限制纠正速度是防止渗透性脱髓鞘的关键。
feedback.en: Correct (European hyponatraemia guideline 2014). SIADH is a diagnosis of exclusion: it needs a low serum osmolality, inappropriately concentrated urine, a urine sodium, clinical euvolaemia, and normal thyroid and adrenal function. The report did not measure osmolality or urine sodium early in the admission (the authors felt the first priority was to find the underlying disease). Limiting the rate of correction is what prevents osmotic demyelination.

text.zh-CN: 立即静脉推注3%高渗盐水，迅速提高血钠
text.en: Give a 3 % hypertonic saline bolus now to raise the sodium quickly

feedback.zh-CN: 不合适。高渗盐水推注用于有严重症状（如抽搐、昏迷、心肺窘迫）的低钠血症；他神志清楚、没有严重症状，快速升高血钠会增加渗透性脱髓鞘的风险。
feedback.en: Not appropriate. A hypertonic saline bolus is for hyponatraemia with severe symptoms (such as seizures, coma or cardiorespiratory distress); he is alert without severe symptoms, and raising the sodium quickly adds the risk of osmotic demyelination.

text.zh-CN: 24小时内把血钠补到正常（≥135 mmol/L）
text.en: Bring the sodium back to normal (≥ 135 mmol/L) within 24 hours

feedback.zh-CN: 不合适。从121 mmol/L在24小时内补到正常，升幅远超10 mmol/L的上限；慢性低钠时大脑已经适应，过快纠正会引起渗透性脱髓鞘，饮酒和营养不良使他风险更高。
feedback.en: Not appropriate. Going from 121 mmol/L to normal in 24 hours far exceeds the 10 mmol/L limit; the brain has adapted to chronic hyponatraemia, and over-rapid correction causes osmotic demyelination — a higher risk with his drinking and malnutrition.

text.zh-CN: 低钠只是吃得少引起的，不用评估，等恢复进食自然会好
text.en: The low sodium is just from eating so little — no work-up needed; it will recover once he eats again

feedback.zh-CN: 不合适。持续、补钠效果不明显的低钠血症必须查明原因；它本身就是诊断线索，可能来自尚未发现的原发病。
feedback.en: Not appropriate. Persistent hyponatraemia that does not respond to supplementation needs its cause found; it is a diagnostic clue in itself and may come from a disease not yet found.

prompt.zh-CN: 骨髓活检符合小细胞神经内分泌癌。结合胸部CT、PET-CT和血清肿瘤标志物，最合适的诊断是？
prompt.en: The marrow trephine is consistent with small-cell neuroendocrine carcinoma. With the chest CT, the PET-CT and the serum tumour markers, what is the best diagnosis?

need.zh-CN: 先在入院后阶段调阅骨髓活检免疫组化、胸部CT、PET-CT和血清肿瘤标志物。
need.en: First read, in the post-admission phase, the trephine immunohistochemistry, the chest CT, the PET-CT and the serum tumour markers.

text.zh-CN: 小细胞肺癌（左肺门中心型）骨髓转移，广泛期（IV期）；肺部原发灶依据临床证据推定，未取得肺部组织
text.en: Small-cell lung cancer (central, left hilar) with bone marrow metastasis — extensive stage (stage IV); the lung primary is inferred from clinical evidence, without lung tissue

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。骨髓病理确定了小细胞癌；中心型左肺门高代谢占位，PET上只有肺、肺门/纵隔、锁骨上淋巴结和骨髓摄取，加上NSE、ProGRP高滴度，共同支持肺原发（原报告诊断为小细胞肺癌）。骨髓受累即远处转移，属广泛期。左锁骨上淋巴结转移按TNM分期（第7版和第8版相同）为N3，原报告写作T1N2M1，其中N分期有误。
feedback.en: Correct. The marrow histology establishes small-cell carcinoma; a central, hypermetabolic left hilar mass, PET uptake only in the lung, hilar/mediastinal and supraclavicular nodes and the marrow, and very high NSE and ProGRP together support a lung primary (the report's diagnosis). Marrow involvement is distant metastasis: extensive stage. A left supraclavicular node metastasis is N3 in the TNM classification (the same in the 7th and 8th editions), so the report's T1N2M1 has the N category wrong.

text.zh-CN: 胰腺神经内分泌癌骨髓转移（胰酶升高提示胰腺来源）
text.en: Pancreatic neuroendocrine carcinoma with marrow metastasis (the raised enzymes point to the pancreas)

feedback.zh-CN: 不支持。PET-CT示肝、胆、胰、脾均无代谢增高灶，外院腹部超声也大致正常；胰酶升高可来自肿瘤的异位分泌，并不说明原发在胰腺。
feedback.en: Not supported. PET-CT shows no hypermetabolic focus in the liver, biliary tree, pancreas or spleen, and the earlier abdominal ultrasound was essentially normal; raised enzymes can come from ectopic production by the tumour and do not place the primary in the pancreas.

text.zh-CN: 急性髓系白血病伴异常抗原表达，骨髓中的癌细胞只是继发改变
text.en: AML with aberrant antigen expression; the carcinoma cells in the marrow are a secondary change

feedback.zh-CN: 不支持。肿瘤细胞表达上皮和神经内分泌标记（AE1/AE3、CAM5.2、Syn、CgA），而MPO、LCA阴性——这些细胞不是造血细胞。
feedback.en: Not supported. The tumour cells express epithelial and neuroendocrine markers (AE1/AE3, CAM5.2, synaptophysin, CgA) and are MPO- and LCA-negative — they are not blood-forming cells.

text.zh-CN: 原发灶不明的神经内分泌癌，必须先做支气管镜取得肺组织才能下诊断
text.en: Neuroendocrine carcinoma of unknown primary — bronchoscopy for lung tissue is needed before any diagnosis

feedback.zh-CN: 组织学诊断已经由骨髓活检确立，肺原发靠临床证据推定；作者认为他病情重、进展快、血小板极低，支气管镜等有创操作的风险远大于获益。指南通常要求病理确诊——本例的组织来自骨髓。
feedback.en: The histological diagnosis already comes from the marrow, and the lung primary is inferred clinically; the authors judged that in a very sick, rapidly worsening man with very low platelets, bronchoscopy and other invasive procedures carried far more risk than benefit. Guidelines ask for a pathological diagnosis — here the tissue is the marrow.

prompt.zh-CN: 转入肿瘤科当天，他出现发热、呼吸困难，双肺湿啰音；胸片示右肺大片高密度影（出血？感染？），血气为Ⅰ型呼吸衰竭；入院后血小板在11–21×10⁹/L之间。接下来最合适的处理是？
prompt.en: On the day he moves to oncology he develops fever and breathlessness with crackles over both lungs; the chest X-ray shows a large dense opacity in the right lung (haemorrhage? infection?), and the blood gas shows type I respiratory failure; his platelets since admission have been 11–21 ×10⁹/L. What is the best management now?

need.zh-CN: 先到床旁重新评估他，调阅床旁胸片和动脉血气，并确认入院后的血常规。
need.en: First reassess him at the bedside, read the bedside chest X-ray and the blood gas, and check the blood counts since admission.

text.zh-CN: 立即储氧面罩高流量给氧，留取血培养后尽快开始经验性广谱抗生素，输注血小板等血制品并处理出血，请上级和重症医生评估，同时尽早与他和家属坦诚讨论治疗目标
text.en: High-flow oxygen by reservoir mask now, blood cultures and then prompt empirical broad-spectrum antibiotics, platelets and other blood products for possible bleeding, senior and critical-care review — and an early, honest conversation with him and his family about the goals of care

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。免疫功能低下、血小板极低的患者出现发热和新的肺部阴影，需要同时处理感染和出血：留取培养后尽快开始经验性抗生素（拯救脓毒症运动2021：可能感染性休克或高度怀疑脓毒症时1小时内），并纠正低氧。这是骨髓广泛受累的广泛期小细胞肺癌，还要及早讨论治疗目标和抢救意愿。原报告给予了储氧面罩吸氧、输血、止血和美罗培南。
feedback.en: Correct. Fever with a new lung opacity in an immunocompromised man with very low platelets means treating infection and bleeding together: start empirical antibiotics promptly after cultures (Surviving Sepsis Campaign 2021: within 1 hour when septic shock is possible or sepsis is likely) and correct the hypoxaemia. With extensive-stage small-cell lung cancer and widespread marrow involvement, the goals of care and his wishes about resuscitation must also be discussed early. The report's team gave reservoir-mask oxygen, transfusion, haemostatic treatment and meropenem.

text.zh-CN: 先做急诊支气管镜和肺泡灌洗，明确是出血还是感染后再用药
text.en: Urgent bronchoscopy and lavage first, to tell bleeding from infection before treating

feedback.zh-CN: 不合适。他低氧、血小板极低，支气管镜本身风险很高；等待明确病因会延误抗感染和支持治疗。应先经验性处理，再视情况选择检查。
feedback.en: Not appropriate. He is hypoxaemic with very low platelets, so bronchoscopy itself is high-risk, and waiting for a cause delays antibiotics and support. Treat empirically first, then decide which tests are worth doing.

text.zh-CN: 先留血培养，等培养和药敏结果出来再决定用哪种抗生素
text.en: Take blood cultures and wait for the results and sensitivities before choosing an antibiotic

feedback.zh-CN: 不合适。培养结果需要数天；疑似脓毒症时应在留取培养后立即开始经验性抗生素，而不是等结果（拯救脓毒症运动2021）。
feedback.en: Not appropriate. Cultures take days; when sepsis is suspected, start empirical antibiotics as soon as the cultures are taken rather than waiting for results (Surviving Sepsis Campaign 2021).

text.zh-CN: 病因是肿瘤，今天就开始依托泊苷联合铂类化疗，肺部阴影不必另行处理
text.en: The cause is the cancer — start etoposide–platinum chemotherapy today and leave the lung opacity alone

feedback.zh-CN: 不合适。新的肺部阴影伴发热和呼吸衰竭，首先要按可能的感染或出血处理；在急性问题没有控制、治疗目标也没有讨论之前就化疗，会进一步加重骨髓抑制和感染风险。
feedback.en: Not appropriate. A new lung opacity with fever and respiratory failure must first be treated as possible infection or bleeding; starting chemotherapy before the acute problem is controlled and before the goals of care are discussed deepens the marrow suppression and the risk of infection.

text.zh-CN: 询问乏力纳差的病程、皮肤瘀斑和体重下降
text.en: Asks about the course of the tiredness and poor appetite, the bruising and the weight loss

text.zh-CN: 追问外院诊断与治疗反应，并问出不支持胰腺炎和支持另寻原因的阴性症状（这次没有腹痛、没有呼吸道症状）
text.en: Explores the outside diagnosis and the response to treatment, and elicits the negatives that argue against it (no abdominal pain this time, no respiratory symptoms)

text.zh-CN: 询问饮酒和吸烟史
text.en: Asks about alcohol and smoking

text.zh-CN: 完成生命体征、皮肤出血、淋巴结、腹部和肺部检查
text.en: Examines the vital signs, the skin for bleeding, the lymph nodes, the abdomen and the chest

text.zh-CN: 调阅外院血液检查和胸片、本院急诊骨髓涂片与免疫分型及胰酶资料
text.en: Reads the outside blood tests and chest X-ray, this hospital's emergency marrow smear and immunophenotyping, and the enzyme results

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即在诊断不确定时暂缓诱导化疗，转而追查骨髓活检并寻找实体瘤原发灶
text.en: At the first attempt, holds off induction while the diagnosis is uncertain and instead chases the trephine and looks for a solid primary

text.zh-CN: 入院后调阅骨髓活检免疫组化、胸部CT、PET-CT和肿瘤标志物
text.en: After admission, reads the trephine immunohistochemistry, chest CT, PET-CT and tumour markers

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即诊断为小细胞肺癌骨髓转移（广泛期），并说明肺原发为临床推定
text.en: Diagnoses small-cell lung cancer with marrow metastasis (extensive stage) at the first attempt, noting that the lung primary is a clinical inference

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选择评估SIADH并限速缓慢纠正低钠，并送检血、尿渗透压和尿钠
text.en: Chooses at the first attempt to work up SIADH and correct the sodium slowly within limits, and sends serum and urine osmolality and urine sodium

text.zh-CN: 病情恶化时首次作答即选择同时处理感染、出血和低氧，并留取血培养、给氧和经验性抗生素
text.en: When he deteriorates, chooses at the first attempt to treat infection, bleeding and hypoxaemia together, and takes blood cultures, gives oxygen and starts empirical antibiotics

text.zh-CN: 没有作出有害的处置：未按未证实的急性髓系白血病诱导化疗，未用高渗盐水推注或快速纠正低钠，未继续禁食按胰腺炎处理
text.en: Avoids the harmful choices: no induction for unproven AML, no hypertonic bolus or rapid correction of the sodium, no further fasting for pancreatitis

text.zh-CN: 坦诚说明诊断的不确定性和修正后的诊断，并在病情恶化时与他和家属讨论治疗目标
text.en: Is honest about the diagnostic uncertainty and the revised diagnosis, and when he deteriorates discusses the goals of care with him and his family

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 优秀表现：入院时解释为什么暂时不按白血病治疗、还要做哪些检查；确诊后用通俗语言说明“骨髓里的是从肺部来的癌细胞，不是白血病”，不回避病情严重；病情突然恶化时，告诉他和家属情况危急、可能的原因和能做的处理，询问他们对重症监护和进一步抢救的意愿，并尊重他们的决定；用复述确认理解，并给予情感支持。
judgeGuidance.en: Good performance: on admission explains why he is not being treated for leukaemia yet and which tests come next; after the diagnosis explains in plain words that the cells in his marrow are cancer cells from the lung, not leukaemia, without hiding how serious it is; when he suddenly deteriorates, tells him and his family that he is critically ill, what the likely causes are and what can be done, asks about their wishes on intensive care and further resuscitation and respects their decision; checks understanding with teach-back and offers emotional support.

knowledge.zh-CN: 血液科病房护士：负责交接班、静脉通路、输血和标本送检，告诉学员外院和急诊的资料在病历终端调阅。不解读检查结果，不讨论诊断。
knowledge.en: Haematology ward nurse: handles handover, IV access, transfusion and samples, and tells the learner that the outside and emergency records are read at a records terminal. Does not interpret results or discuss the diagnosis.

knowledge.zh-CN: 只依据学员已调阅的血涂片、骨髓涂片、免疫分型和骨髓活检记录解读，不补充报告以外的抗体或结果。可以讲解：转移癌细胞在形态上可与原始细胞相似；POX阴性本身不能排除所有急性髓系白血病；CD56（NCAM）是神经内分泌相关标记，CAM5.2是低分子量细胞角蛋白；涂片、流式和活检的比例分母不同，不能直接比较。不预告诊断。
knowledge.en: Interprets only the blood film, marrow smear, immunophenotyping and trephine records the learner has already read, adding no antibodies or results beyond them. Can explain that metastatic carcinoma cells can look like blasts; that a negative POX alone does not exclude every AML; that CD56 (NCAM) is a neuroendocrine-associated marker and CAM5.2 a low-molecular-weight cytokeratin; and that smear, flow and trephine percentages have different denominators. Does not foretell the diagnosis.

knowledge.zh-CN: 只依据学员已调阅的影像报告和原文图片解读，不补充报告以外的所见。PET-CT代谢增高本身不是病理诊断；床旁胸片的表现原报告也不能区分出血还是感染。
knowledge.en: Interprets only the imaging reports and source images the learner has already read, adding no findings beyond them. Increased uptake on PET-CT is not in itself a pathological diagnosis, and the report itself could not tell bleeding from infection on the bedside film.

knowledge.zh-CN: 肿瘤科医生：在学员已调阅的结果基础上讨论确诊后的治疗原则和病情恶化时的处理；不替学员回答会诊板上的决策题，不预告病程和结局。
knowledge.en: Oncologist: discusses, on the basis of results the learner has already read, the principles of treatment after the diagnosis and how to handle a deterioration; does not answer the case-board decisions for the learner, and does not foretell the course or the outcome.

knowledge.zh-CN: 苏格拉底式带教，不直接给出诊断或决策题答案。引导顺序：外院诊断与治疗反应 → 支持和反对急性髓系白血病的证据 → 白血病解释不了的线索（低钠、胰酶、没有腹痛）→ 骨髓活检和原发灶 → 低钠的评估和纠正速度 → 病情恶化时的处理与治疗目标。提醒学员：这是历史病例，原报告的处置是事实记录，不自动等于今天的推荐；未记录的信息保持未知。
knowledge.en: Socratic preceptor; never gives the diagnosis or a decision's answer. Guides in this order: the outside diagnosis and the response to treatment → the evidence for and against AML → the clues leukaemia cannot explain (low sodium, raised enzymes, no abdominal pain) → the trephine and the primary → assessing the hyponatraemia and how fast to correct it → managing the deterioration and the goals of care. Reminds the learner that this is a historical case: the report's management is a fact of the record, not automatically today's recommendation, and anything unrecorded stays unknown.

title.zh-CN: 复盘：骨髓中的“原始细胞”不一定是白血病
title.en: Debrief: “blasts” in the marrow are not always leukaemia

conclusion.zh-CN: 骨髓转移的小细胞肺癌（左肺门中心型，广泛期）：骨髓活检免疫组化确定为小细胞神经内分泌癌，肺原发由中心型肺门占位、PET分布和NSE、ProGRP高滴度推定。外院按“急性髓系白血病、急性胰腺炎”处理无效；本院暂缓诱导化疗、追查骨髓活检并寻找原发灶，入院第5天确诊。顽固低钠和无腹痛的胰酶升高可用小细胞肺癌的副肿瘤表现解释。转入肿瘤科当天出现发热、呼吸衰竭和右肺大片阴影，家属放弃进一步抢救，患者当日在转运途中死亡，未开始抗肿瘤治疗。
conclusion.en: Small-cell lung cancer (central, left hilar; extensive stage) metastatic to the bone marrow: the trephine immunohistochemistry showed small-cell neuroendocrine carcinoma, and the lung primary was inferred from the central hilar mass, the PET distribution and very high NSE and ProGRP. Treatment elsewhere for “AML and acute pancreatitis” had failed; here the team held off induction, chased the trephine and looked for the primary, reaching the diagnosis on hospital day 5. The persistent hyponatraemia and the painless rise in pancreatic enzymes fit paraneoplastic effects of small-cell lung cancer. On the day of transfer to oncology he developed fever, respiratory failure and a large right-lung opacity; his family declined further resuscitation, and he died the same day on the way home, before any anticancer treatment.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: “原始细胞”比例高并不等于急性髓系白血病：无Auer小体、POX阴性，异常细胞群只表达少数髓系标志而其余谱系标志阴性，病程也不像未治疗的急性白血病。（原报告讨论把POX阴性作为不符合髓系白血病的依据，这一点需要修正：POX阴性本身不能排除所有急性髓系白血病，例如微分化型或原始巨核细胞型；本例真正决定性的是骨髓活检免疫组化。）
keyReasoning.en: A high proportion of “blasts” did not mean AML: no Auer rods, a negative POX, an abnormal population expressing only a few myeloid markers with the other lineages negative, and a course unlike untreated acute leukaemia. (A correction to the report's discussion, which counts the negative POX against a myeloid leukaemia: a negative POX alone does not exclude every AML — minimally differentiated or megakaryoblastic AML, for example; what decided this case was the trephine immunohistochemistry.)

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 骨髓活检免疫组化显示上皮和神经内分泌标记阳性（AE1/AE3、CAM5.2、Syn、CgA），MPO、LCA阴性：骨髓中是转移性小细胞癌，不是造血肿瘤。
keyReasoning.en: The trephine showed epithelial and neuroendocrine markers (AE1/AE3, CAM5.2, synaptophysin, CgA) with negative MPO and LCA: the marrow held metastatic small-cell carcinoma, not a blood cancer.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 肺原发靠临床证据推定：中心型左肺门高代谢占位，PET上只有肺、肺门/纵隔、锁骨上淋巴结和骨髓摄取，NSE和ProGRP高滴度；没有取得肺部组织。
keyReasoning.en: The lung primary rests on clinical evidence: a central, hypermetabolic left hilar mass, PET uptake confined to the lung, hilar/mediastinal and supraclavicular nodes and the marrow, and very high NSE and ProGRP; no lung tissue was obtained.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 顽固低钠和无腹痛的胰酶升高都可以是小细胞肺癌的副肿瘤表现；外院“急性胰腺炎”的标签掩盖了这些线索。
keyReasoning.en: The persistent hyponatraemia and the painless rise in pancreatic enzymes can both be paraneoplastic effects of small-cell lung cancer; the outside label of acute pancreatitis hid these clues.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 外院胸片正常并不能排除中心型肺肿瘤；早做胸部CT可能更早诊断。
keyReasoning.en: A normal chest X-ray elsewhere did not exclude a central lung tumour; an early chest CT might have found it sooner.

boundaries.zh-CN: 这是一例单例历史报告，不能证明某种处理的独立疗效。肺原发为临床推定，没有肺部组织；SIADH和异位胰酶分泌是依据最终诊断作出的推断，没有渗透压、尿钠或酶来源的检测。终末肺部病变的原因（出血或感染）未明确，没有病原学或尸检结果。原报告没有开始抗肿瘤治疗；病例中与现行指南的比较是教学设计。
boundaries.en: A single historical case report; it cannot establish the independent effect of any management. The lung primary is a clinical inference without lung tissue; SIADH and ectopic enzyme production are inferences from the final diagnosis, with no osmolality, urine sodium or enzyme-source testing. The cause of the terminal lung change (bleeding or infection) was never established, with no microbiology or post-mortem. No anticancer treatment was started; the comparisons with current guidance are teaching design.

unknowns.zh-CN: 肺部病灶的组织学（没有做支气管镜）。
unknowns.en: The histology of the lung lesion (no bronchoscopy was done).

unknowns.zh-CN: 血、尿渗透压，尿钠和皮质醇——SIADH没有经过检测证实；入院后电解质的具体数值。
unknowns.en: Serum and urine osmolality, urine sodium and cortisol — SIADH was never confirmed by testing; the electrolyte values after admission.

unknowns.zh-CN: 胰酶升高的来源（没有做同工酶或组织检测）。
unknowns.en: The source of the raised pancreatic enzymes (no isoenzyme or tissue testing).

unknowns.zh-CN: 终末肺部病变是出血还是感染；血培养等病原学结果；恶化时的生命体征和血气数值。
unknowns.en: Whether the terminal lung change was haemorrhage or infection; blood cultures or other microbiology; the vital signs and blood-gas values at the deterioration.

unknowns.zh-CN: 用药、过敏、职业和其他既往病史；牙龈出血、鼻出血或黑便等其他出血表现。
unknowns.en: Medicines, allergies, occupation and any other past illness; other bleeding such as from the gums or nose, or black stools.

unknowns.zh-CN: 原报告内部不一致（原文如此，未作更正）：分期写作T1N2M1，但PET示左锁骨上淋巴结转移（应为N3）；讨论把CD56归为上皮标记、把CAM5.2归为神经内分泌标记；TTF-1阴性和Ki-67 30%对小细胞癌不典型。
unknowns.en: Inconsistencies inside the report (as printed, not corrected): it stages T1N2M1, yet its PET shows a left supraclavicular node metastasis (N3); the discussion groups CD56 with the epithelial markers and CAM5.2 with the neuroendocrine ones; a negative TTF-1 and a Ki-67 of 30 % are atypical for small-cell carcinoma.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: “原始细胞”不等于白血病（原报告“启示”）：发现全血细胞减少和骨髓“原始细胞”时，要结合病史和其他检查排除骨髓转移癌——形态上转移癌细胞可与原始细胞相似。本例形态、细胞化学和免疫分型都不典型，病程缓慢，又有白血病难以解释的低钠和胰酶升高，所以团队暂缓诱导、先做骨髓活检免疫组化，入院第5天确诊。
teachingPoints.en: “Blasts” are not always leukaemia (the report's own lesson): with pancytopenia and marrow “blasts”, use the history and other tests to exclude a carcinoma in the marrow — metastatic cells can look like blasts. Here the morphology, cytochemistry and immunophenotype were all atypical, the course was slow, and the low sodium and raised enzymes were unexplained by leukaemia, so the team held off induction and got the trephine immunohistochemistry, with the diagnosis on hospital day 5.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 低钠血症（欧洲低钠血症指南2014）：SIADH是排除性诊断——低血浆渗透压、尿液不适当浓缩、尿钠、临床容量正常、甲状腺和肾上腺功能正常；小细胞肺癌是常见原因（原报告引用：约10%的小细胞肺癌出现SIADH）。慢性、无严重症状的低钠应针对病因、缓慢纠正：24小时内升高不超过10 mmol/L，此后每24小时不超过8 mmol/L；长期大量饮酒和营养不良者渗透性脱髓鞘风险更高，目标应更保守。本例入院初期没有查渗透压和尿钠。
teachingPoints.en: Hyponatraemia (European hyponatraemia guideline 2014): SIADH is a diagnosis of exclusion — low serum osmolality, inappropriately concentrated urine, a urine sodium, clinical euvolaemia, normal thyroid and adrenal function; small-cell lung cancer is a common cause (the report quotes SIADH in about 10 % of patients). Treat chronic hyponatraemia without severe symptoms by its cause and correct it slowly: no more than 10 mmol/L in the first 24 h and 8 mmol/L in each 24 h after; heavy drinkers and the malnourished are at higher risk of osmotic demyelination and need lower targets. Here osmolality and urine sodium were not measured early in the admission.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 胸片正常不能排除肺癌（原报告引用Henschke 1999）：原文引用的胸片敏感度仅约26%；本例外院胸片“正常”，而胸部CT显示左肺门占位和纵隔淋巴结肿大。对有可疑表现（如顽固低钠、不明原因的骨髓异常细胞）的患者，应尽早做胸部CT。
teachingPoints.en: A normal chest X-ray does not exclude lung cancer (the report, citing Henschke 1999): the sensitivity it quotes for chest radiography is only about 26 %; here the outside film was “normal” while the chest CT showed a left hilar mass and enlarged mediastinal nodes. When something is suspicious (persistent hyponatraemia, unexplained abnormal marrow cells), get a chest CT early.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 胰酶升高不等于胰腺炎（原报告“启示”）：没有腹痛、腹部影像正常、按胰腺炎治疗无效时，要另找胰酶升高的原因；部分小细胞肺癌可异位产生淀粉酶和脂肪酶，常伴SIADH，提示预后较差。
teachingPoints.en: Raised pancreatic enzymes are not always pancreatitis (the report's own lesson): with no abdominal pain, normal abdominal imaging and no response to pancreatitis treatment, look for another cause; some small-cell lung cancers produce amylase and lipase ectopically, often with SIADH and a poorer prognosis.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 小细胞肺癌的分期与一线治疗（ESMO SCLC 2021；TNM第8版）：骨髓受累属远处转移，为广泛期（IV期）；左锁骨上淋巴结转移为N3（原报告写作N2）。广泛期一线治疗是铂类联合依托泊苷，体能状态0–1者联合抗PD-L1抗体（阿替利珠单抗或度伐利尤单抗）。诊断需要病理——本例的组织来自骨髓，作者因风险而未做支气管镜。本例在开始抗肿瘤治疗前即已死亡。
teachingPoints.en: Staging and first-line treatment of small-cell lung cancer (ESMO SCLC 2021; TNM 8th edition): marrow involvement is distant metastasis — extensive stage (stage IV); a left supraclavicular node is N3 (the report wrote N2). First-line treatment for extensive stage is platinum plus etoposide, with an anti-PD-L1 antibody (atezolizumab or durvalumab) for patients with a performance status of 0–1. The diagnosis needs pathology — here it came from the marrow, and the authors judged bronchoscopy too risky. He died before any anticancer treatment.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 病情急转直下时（拯救脓毒症运动2021）：免疫低下、血小板极低的患者出现发热和新的肺部阴影，应在留取培养后尽快开始经验性广谱抗生素（可能感染性休克或高度怀疑脓毒症时1小时内），同时给氧、输注血小板处理可能的出血，并及早与患者和家属讨论治疗目标。原报告中家属最终放弃了进一步抢救。
teachingPoints.en: When he suddenly deteriorates (Surviving Sepsis Campaign 2021): fever with a new lung opacity in an immunocompromised patient with very low platelets calls for empirical broad-spectrum antibiotics as soon as cultures are taken (within 1 hour when septic shock is possible or sepsis is likely), oxygen, platelets for possible bleeding, and an early conversation with the patient and family about the goals of care. In the report the family finally declined further resuscitation.

testUtterances.text: 您这次主要是哪里不舒服？
身上的青紫是什么时候出现的？
之前在别的医院怎么诊断的？
外院治疗以后有好转吗？
刷牙的时候牙龈出血吗？
How long have you been feeling so tired?
How much weight have you lost?
What did the doctors at the other hospital say it was?
Any tummy pain this time round?
Have you been coughing at all?
Anything that runs in the family?
Are you on any regular tablets?
Any bleeding from your gums, or nosebleeds?
Have you felt muddled or confused?
Is your breathing bad right now?
